SSC/US dba USN request a 180-day STA to continue supporting the Jaxa XRISM mission from its Hawaii station commencing on Jan. 1st 2027. This is a continuation of SES-STA-20260216-00760. On Apr. 9th 2025, USN submitted an application for a long-term license.

SSC Space (dba USN) is requesting a 180 day STA to commence on Jan.1st 2027 supporting TTC and payload data downlink of the Sentinel 2C satellite. This is a continuation of SES-STA-20260205-00550. The Sentinel 2C is to fly tandem with Sentinel 2A during LEOP and commissioning phase. When Sentinel 2C commissioning phase is completed then Sentinel 2A is to be retired and replaced with Sentinel 2C.

SSC Space US (dba USN) request a 180 day STA to support Eumetsat's Metop-SG A1&B1 TT&C operations from its Alaska North Pole station commencing Jan. 2nd 2027.  Eumetsat/Metop has critical partnership with NOAA since over 35 years.  On Oct. 7th 2024 a long-term license application for Metop-SG was submitted, SES-LIC-20241007-02057.
